title: sec-agent Audit Log Entry Schema
description: JSON Schema for sec-agent security flight log audit records (audit.log)

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of audit event

profile.description: Target secret profile (e.g. default, dev, prod)

store_file_path.description: Explicit physical database filename on disk (e.g. ~/.config/sec-agent/secrets.enc)

master_key_sha256.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA-256(masterKey) fingerprint

process_name.description: Executable process binary name of calling process (e.g. sec-agent, zsh)

actor.description: OS user or process actor string

value_length.description: Secret value length in bytes (NEVER plaintext value)

error.description: Error message string if operation failed
